findings.reproduced: 5 of 24 environment-proxy handshakes failed at socks.start_tls with SSLEOFError / UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING. TCP and SOCKS setup completed; HTTP headers/body were not sent. All 24 interleaved direct connections succeeded.
findings.case_content: Six paired first-decision requests (map/greeting, including the prior frozen reference) succeeded on both routes during the initial diagnostic period. No tools executed in these diagnostic calls.
findings.historical_limit: Old audits stored only ConnectError, not its cause. The reproduced mechanism and proxy dependency are established; the precise upstream component closing TLS and the cause of every historical event cannot be reconstructed.
findings.scope: Failure is reproducible without any task text or model call, so it is not specific to the map repair task. Prior runs also contain recovered ConnectErrors on other cases.
findings.repair: Make environment proxy/CA inheritance explicit and default model calls to direct; preserve TLS verification and the existing three-attempt cap; audit bounded phase names and safe machine codes.
